verdict.rationale: An office suite could plausibly ship natural-language command control, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only structured CLI start parameters, headless and UNO API control, and macros. These are developer building blocks or scripted interfaces, not natural-language operation, so they earn no credit. Plain-text formula entry and LanguageTool grammar checking are adjacent features, not natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
